name: PalPanelServerMods
description: Server-only Community-Raid build with the proven Arena v2 3500-unit keep-in boundary unchanged. Step 2A adds a strictly read-only discovery pass over loaded Blueprint classes and the cooked AssetRegistry to identify vanilla arena/barrier visual assets before any visual actor is spawned. No new world mutation, NPC spawn, actor spawn, collision edit, AI edit, RPC or visual effect is introduced by the discovery module. No client installation required.
